title: Ham (Egypt)
summary: Ham (Egypt) is dated in Raleigh's chronological table (1617), column Kings of Aegypt , by a yeere of the World. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person.
description: Added from the Raleigh import (The History of the World, 1617). Raleigh is display-only. He gives a yeere of the World, not a BC year, and no tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: Calculated from printed figures. No tier 1–4 birth, no tier reign start, and no provisional year. Raleigh prints the yeere of the World 1848. Creation is 4032 BC (Kevin, 2026-10-28). BC = 4033 − AM, so AM 1848 = 2185 BC. The figure is not written into year_bc_ad. A printed year for this person would replace it.

calculated.citation: Raleigh, The History of the World (1617, EEBO-TCP A10357), Chronological Table, sig. 782a
calculated.arithmetic: Raleigh prints the yeere of the World 1848. Creation is 4032 BC (Kevin, 2026-10-28). BC = 4033 − AM, so AM 1848 = 2185 BC. The figure is not written into year_bc_ad.

reign.citation: Raleigh, The History of the World (1617, EEBO-TCP A10357), Chronological Table, sig. 782a
reign.note: Year cell "2530 1848 191". The third printed figure 191 is the column "Floud", not a length. To the Reader (sig. 780b): the Julian Period exceeds the yeere of the World by 682. The 161 at the end of the name is the reign length he prints. The end year is not printed on this row. Column: Kings of Aegypt ..

reign.citation: Raleigh, The History of the World (1617, EEBO-TCP A10357), Book II, Part I, Chapter II, §. I, sig. 168a
reign.note: Body intake. The table in this section is headed An. Mundi and prints 1847. The chronological table already prints 1848 (sig. 782a), which is the stored yeere of the World on this reign. Two World years in one slot are not calculated (N35). year_am stays null on this sentence. year_bc_ad stays null. This does not change the sort.

reign.date: CHAMS reigne in Aegypt began in the yeere after the Floud, 191
